## Checklist

- [ ] Filename matches the app package id (apps) or a manufacturer slug (device)
- [ ] Every user-facing field is filled in — the catalog is English only
- [ ] `impact` is set honestly (high / medium / low)
- [ ] Steps verified against the **current** app or OS version
- [ ] `why` says what changes, not why someone should feel bad
- [ ] Trade-offs described honestly
- [ ] Media (if any) recorded on a clean profile with no personal information, animated WebP, and checked that it actually plays
- [ ] Ran `python3 tools/validate_content.py` locally with no errors
- [ ] I did **not** edit `content/index.json` — it is generated and signed on merge
